(nicomorphine) Profile Nicomorphine hydrochloride is an opioid analgesic (p.101) used in the treatment of moderate to severe pain. It is given in oral doses of 5 to 10 mg daily or by intramuscular, slow intravenous, or subcutaneous injection in doses of 10 to 20 mg; higher doses have also been used. It may also be given rectally in usual doses of 10 to 20 mg daily. ◊ References. 1. Koopman-Kimenai PM, et al.
